newsitem.title: ROMANIA: NEW IMF ACCORD ON ROMANIAN CABINET'S AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: NEW IMF ACCORD ON ROMANIAN CABINET'S AGENDA.

text.p: Romania is optimistic about its prospects to sign a new memorandum with the International Monetary Fund as well as a new structural adjustment loan accord with the World Bank, the government said on Monday.

"The government believes the country's economic situation can be kept under control and a new memorandum with the IMF will be concluded as soon as possible," Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea told a news conference at the end of his cabinet's first meeting since creation last week.
He said the government would aslo be able to sign a new and more advantageous financial and enterprise structural adjustment loan (FESAL) with the World Bank.

An IMF technical mission visited Romania last week to evaluate the country's economy, including the 1996 budget deficit and the current account gap, as pre-requisites for negotiating a new memorandum with the Balkan country.
"The IMF is explicitly supporting our governing programme," Ciorbea said. He said the Fund had asked the government to postpone to January 15 steps to increased child benefits.
"We need a coherent programme to support our social protection measures," the Finance Minister Mircea Ciumara said.
Other items on the cabinet's agenda included:
* allocation of 2.5 billion lei worth of aid to the eastern village of Parcovaci where more than 100 households were destroyed by landslides.
* decree to allow the government to rule by decree during parliament's winter recess due until early February.
* decree to allow Petrolexportimport SA state-run oil trader to benefit from a Chase Manhattan Bank $200 million credit to fund crude imports this winter.
* decree to declare December 30 and 31, as well as January 3 public holidays. December 25 and 26 and January 1 and 2 are also public holidays under the law.
* measure to appoint film director Stere Gulea interim chairman of the Romanian Television pending an appointment by the parliament.
* decree to re-allocate 145 billion lei under ministers' budget to pay state employees' wages in the second half of December.
